fullText.simplified:
十二、战争结束了

    木兰不但要保护国家，而且要保护她的战友们，她想和大家一起平安回家。但是这里是战场啊！战场上每天有多少人受伤，又有多少人死啊！有时候，刚刚还在跟她说话的战友，下一分钟就死在了她的身边，这让她难过极了。木兰想哭，想大叫，想结束这一场又一场的战争。
    突然，木兰觉得身边开始变得很安静，慢慢地，她好像什么都听不见了。她只能看到士兵们的嘴张得大大的，士兵的马冲向别的马，士兵们从马上摔下来。她看到有人在打鼓，有人在向前冲，但是她什么声音都听不到。红色，她的眼前又是红色，那是战马的血，那是她战友的血……
    这时候，木兰好像又想起来了什么。时间好像回到三个月前，她和战友们刚刚开始练习。他们一起在骑马场上练习，他们一起听课学习兵法，他们一起跟老师学功夫，他们一起练剑，一起爬山。短短的几分钟里，这些都像电影一样，出现在木兰的脑子里。突然，木兰大叫了一声，再次冲到了战场的最前面。
    木兰身边的战友注意到了她，他们也大叫了一声，跟着木兰一起冲到了战场的最前面。这些人啊，他们不只是士兵，他们是战士！
    是的，他们是战士！他们什么都不怕，他们要保护身边的人，他们要保护自己的国家！
    ……
    终于等到这一天，战争结束了。
    终于等到这一天，国家太平了。
    终于等到这一天，木兰和她的战友们可以回家了。
    等到这一天用了多久？
    十年。
fullText.traditional:
十二、戰爭結束了

    木蘭不但要保護國家，而且要保護她的戰友們，她想和大家一起平安回家。但是這裡是戰場啊！戰場上每天有多少人受傷，又有多少人死啊！有時候，剛剛還在跟她說話的戰友，下一分鐘就死在了她的身邊，這讓她難過極了。木蘭想哭，想大叫，想結束這一場又一場的戰爭。
    突然，木蘭覺得身邊開始變得很安靜，慢慢地，她好像什麼都聽不見了。她只能看到士兵們的嘴張得大大的，士兵的馬衝嚮別的馬，士兵們從馬上摔下來。她看到有人在打鼓，有人在向前衝，但是她什麼聲音都聽不到。紅色，她的眼前又是紅色，那是戰馬的血，那是她戰友的血……
    這時候，木蘭好像又想起來了什麼。時間好像回到三個月前，她和戰友們剛剛開始練習。他們一起在騎馬場上練習，他們一起聽課學習兵法，他們一起跟老師學功夫，他們一起練劍，一起爬山。短短的幾分鐘裡，這些都像電影一樣，出現在木蘭的腦子裡。突然，木蘭大叫了一聲，再次衝到了戰場的最前面。
    木蘭身邊的戰友注意到了她，他們也大叫了一聲，跟著木蘭一起衝到了戰場的最前面。這些人啊，他們不只是士兵，他們是戰士！
    是的，他們是戰士！他們什麼都不怕，他們要保護身邊的人，他們要保護自己的國家！
    ……
    終於等到這一天，戰爭結束了。
    終於等到這一天，國家太平了。
    終於等到這一天，木蘭和她的戰友們可以回家了。
    等到這一天用了多久？
    十年。

sentences.simplified: 木兰不但要保护国家，而且要保护她的战友们，她想和大家一起平安回家。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭不但要保護國家，而且要保護她的戰友們，她想和大家一起平安回家。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán bú dàn yào bǎo hù guó jiā ér qiě yào bǎo hù tā de zhàn yǒu men tā xiǎng hé dà jiā yì qǐ píng ān huí jiā
sentences.english: Mulan not only wanted to protect the country, but also her comrades. She wanted to return home safely with everyone.

sentences.simplified: 但是这里是战场啊！战场上每天有多少人受伤，又有多少人死啊！
sentences.traditional: 但是這裡是戰場啊！戰場上每天有多少人受傷，又有多少人死啊！
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè lǐ shì zhàn chǎng a zhàn chǎng shang měi tiān yǒu duō shao rén shòu shāng yòu yǒu duō shao rén sǐ a
sentences.english: But this was a battlefield! How many people get injured every day on the battlefield, and how many die!

sentences.simplified: 有时候，刚刚还在跟她说话的战友，下一分钟就死在了她的身边，这让她难过极了。
sentences.traditional: 有時候，剛剛還在跟她說話的戰友，下一分鐘就死在了她的身邊，這讓她難過極了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu shí hou gāng gang hái zài gēn tā shuō huà de zhàn yǒu xià yì fēn zhōng jiù sǐ zài le tā de shēn biān zhè ràng tā nán guò jí le
sentences.english: Sometimes, the comrade she was just talking to would die right next to her the next minute. This made her extremely sad.

sentences.simplified: 木兰想哭，想大叫，想结束这一场又一场的战争。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭想哭，想大叫，想結束這一場又一場的戰爭。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán xiǎng kū xiǎng dà jiào xiǎng jié shù zhè yì cháng yòu yì cháng de zhàn zhēng
sentences.english: Mulan wanted to cry, wanted to scream, and wanted to put an end to these endless wars.

sentences.simplified: 突然，木兰觉得身边开始变得很安静，
sentences.traditional: 突然，木蘭覺得身邊開始變得很安靜，
sentences.pinyin: tū rán mù lán jué de shēn biān kāi shǐ biàn de hěn ān jìng
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mulan felt everything around her starting to become very quiet.

sentences.simplified: 慢慢地，她好像什么都听不见了。
sentences.traditional: 慢慢地，她好像什麼都聽不見了。
sentences.pinyin: màn man de tā hǎo xiàng shén me dōu tīng bú jiàn le
sentences.english: Gradually, it seemed as though she couldn’t hear anything at all.

sentences.simplified: 她只能看到士兵们的嘴张得大大的，士兵的马冲向别的马，士兵们从马上摔下来。
sentences.traditional: 她只能看到士兵們的嘴張得大大的，士兵的馬衝嚮別的馬，士兵們從馬上摔下來。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ néng kàn dào shì bīng men de zuǐ zhāng de dà dà de shì bīng de mǎ chōng xiàng bié de mǎ shì bīng men cóng mǎ shang shuāi xià lái
sentences.english: She could only see the soldiers’ mouths wide open, horses charging at each other, and soldiers falling off their horses.

sentences.simplified: 她看到有人在打鼓，有人在向前冲，但是她什么声音都听不到。
sentences.traditional: 她看到有人在打鼓，有人在向前衝，但是她什麼聲音都聽不到。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn dào yǒu rén zài dǎ gǔ yǒu rén zài xiàng qián chōng dàn shì tā shén me shēng yīn dōu tīng bú dào
sentences.english: She saw people beating drums and people charging forward, but she couldn’t hear a single sound.

sentences.simplified: 红色，她的眼前又是红色，那是战马的血，那是她战友的血……
sentences.traditional: 紅色，她的眼前又是紅色，那是戰馬的血，那是她戰友的血……
sentences.pinyin: hóng sè tā de yǎn qián yòu shì hóng sè nà shì zhàn mǎ de xiě nà shì tā zhàn yǒu de xiě
sentences.english: Red, red appeared before her eyes again. It was the blood of the warhorses, the blood of her comrades …

sentences.simplified: 这时候，木兰好像又想起来了什么。
sentences.traditional: 這時候，木蘭好像又想起來了什麼。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí hou mù lán hǎo xiàng yòu xiǎng qǐ lái le shén me
sentences.english: At that moment, it seemed as though Mulan remembered something.

sentences.simplified: 时间好像回到三个月前，她和战友们刚刚开始练习。
sentences.traditional: 時間好像回到三個月前，她和戰友們剛剛開始練習。
sentences.pinyin: shí jiān hǎo xiàng huí dào sān ge yuè qián tā hé zhàn yǒu men gāng gang kāi shǐ liàn xí
sentences.english: It felt like time had returned to three months ago when she and her comrades had just started practicing.

sentences.simplified: 他们一起在骑马场上练习，他们一起听课学习兵法，
sentences.traditional: 他們一起在騎馬場上練習，他們一起聽課學習兵法，
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì qǐ zài qí mǎ chǎng shang liàn xí tā men yì qǐ tīng kè xué xí bīng fǎ
sentences.english: They practiced together at the riding ground, attended classes to study military strategy together, ..

sentences.simplified: 他们一起跟老师学功夫，他们一起练剑，一起爬山。
sentences.traditional: 他們一起跟老師學功夫，他們一起練劍，一起爬山。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì qǐ gēn lǎo shī xué gōng fu tā men yì qǐ liàn jiàn yì qǐ pá shān
sentences.english: .. learned martial arts from their teacher together, practiced swordsmanship together, and climbed mountains together.

sentences.simplified: 短短的几分钟里，这些都像电影一样，出现在木兰的脑子里。
sentences.traditional: 短短的幾分鐘裡，這些都像電影一樣，出現在木蘭的腦子裡。
sentences.pinyin: duǎn duǎn de jǐ fēn zhōng lǐ zhè xiē dōu xiàng diàn yǐng yí yàng chū xiàn zài mù lán de nǎo zi lǐ
sentences.english: In just a few short minutes, all of these scenes played out in Mulan’s mind like a movie.

sentences.simplified: 突然，木兰大叫了一声，再次冲到了战场的最前面。
sentences.traditional: 突然，木蘭大叫了一聲，再次衝到了戰場的最前面。
sentences.pinyin: tū rán mù lán dà jiào le yì shēng zài cì chōng dào le zhàn chǎng de zuì qián miàn
sentences.english: Suddenly, Mulan let out a loud cry and rushed to the front of the battlefield once again.

sentences.simplified: 木兰身边的战友注意到了她，他们也大叫了一声，跟着木兰一起冲到了战场的最前面。
sentences.traditional: 木蘭身邊的戰友注意到了她，他們也大叫了一聲，跟著木蘭一起衝到了戰場的最前面。
sentences.pinyin: mù lán shēn biān de zhàn yǒu zhù yì dào le tā tā men yě dà jiào le yì shēng gēn zhe mù lán yì qǐ chōng dào le zhàn chǎng de zuì qián miàn
sentences.english: Mulan’s comrades noticed her. They also let out a loud cry and followed Mulan to the front of the battlefield.

sentences.simplified: 这些人啊，他们不只是士兵，他们是战士！
sentences.traditional: 這些人啊，他們不只是士兵，他們是戰士！
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiē rén a tā men bù zhǐ shì shì bīng tā men shì zhàn shì
sentences.english: These people, they were not just soldiers, they were warriors!

sentences.simplified: 是的，他们是战士！他们什么都不怕，他们要保护身边的人，他们要保护自己的国家！
sentences.traditional: 是的，他們是戰士！他們什麼都不怕，他們要保護身邊的人，他們要保護自己的國家！
sentences.pinyin: shì de tā men shì zhàn shì tā men shén me dōu bú pà tā men yào bǎo hù shēn biān de rén tā men yào bǎo hù zì jǐ de guó jiā
sentences.english: That’s right, they were warriors! They feared nothing. They wanted to protect those around them and protect their country!

sentences.simplified: 终于等到这一天，战争结束了。
sentences.traditional: 終於等到這一天，戰爭結束了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú děng dào zhè yì tiān zhàn zhēng jié shù le
sentences.english: Finally, the day arrived when the war ended.

sentences.simplified: 终于等到这一天，国家太平了。
sentences.traditional: 終於等到這一天，國家太平了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú děng dào zhè yì tiān guó jiā tài píng le
sentences.english: Finally, the day arrived when the country was at peace.

sentences.simplified: 终于等到这一天，木兰和她的战友们可以回家了。
sentences.traditional: 終於等到這一天，木蘭和她的戰友們可以回家了。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng yú děng dào zhè yì tiān mù lán hé tā de zhàn yǒu men kě yǐ huí jiā le
sentences.english: Finally, the day arrived when Mulan and her comrades could go home.

sentences.simplified: 等到这一天用了多久？
sentences.traditional: 等到這一天用了多久？
sentences.pinyin: děng dào zhè yì tiān yòng le duō jiǔ
sentences.english: How long did it take to get to this day?

sentences.simplified: 十年。
sentences.traditional: 十年。
sentences.pinyin: shí nián
sentences.english: Ten years.

sentence_translations: (12) The War Is Over
Mulan not only wanted to protect the country, but also her comrades. She wanted to return home safely with everyone.
But this was a battlefield! How many people get injured every day on the battlefield, and how many die!
Sometimes, the comrade she was just talking to would die right next to her the next minute. This made her extremely sad.
Mulan wanted to cry, wanted to scream, and wanted to put an end to these endless wars.
Suddenly, Mulan felt everything around her starting to become very quiet.
Gradually, it seemed as though she couldn’t hear anything at all.
She could only see the soldiers’ mouths wide open, horses charging at each other, and soldiers falling off their horses.
She saw people beating drums and people charging forward, but she couldn’t hear a single sound.
Red, red appeared before her eyes again. It was the blood of the warhorses, the blood of her comrades …
At that moment, it seemed as though Mulan remembered something.
It felt like time had returned to three months ago when she and her comrades had just started practicing.
They practiced together at the riding ground, attended classes to study military strategy together, ..
.. learned martial arts from their teacher together, practiced swordsmanship together, and climbed mountains together.
In just a few short minutes, all of these scenes played out in Mulan’s mind like a movie.
Suddenly, Mulan let out a loud cry and rushed to the front of the battlefield once again.
Mulan’s comrades noticed her. They also let out a loud cry and followed Mulan to the front of the battlefield.
These people, they were not just soldiers, they were warriors!
That’s right, they were warriors! They feared nothing. They wanted to protect those around them and protect their country!
Finally, the day arrived when the war ended.
Finally, the day arrived when the country was at peace.
Finally, the day arrived when Mulan and her comrades could go home.
How long did it take to get to this day?
Ten years.
